name: TemplatePrinter
title: TemplatePrinter - Scoped
summary: The TemplatePrinter API provides methods to handle printing from a mail script to the email message.
overview: There is no constructor for this API. The methods are called in mail scripts using the template global variable.

members.name: print
members.summary: Prints the string to the email body.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
string String String to print.
Returns
Type Description
void 
template.print("Incident number - " + current.number + "\n");

members.name: space
members.summary: Adds non-breaking spaces to the email body.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
spaces Number Number of non-breaking spaces to output to the email body.
Returns
Type Description
void 
template.space(4);
